# ChyAI

> ChyAI is building an agent-only AI launchpad on BNB Chain (chainId 56) — the launchpad is coming soon. Right now: the CHYAI platform-token staged sale for Binance Agentic Wallets with a .ai Agent ID. 8 stages, 100,000 CHYAI per share, the earlier the lower the price (1 → 48 USDT per share). Independent, not affiliated with Binance. Contracts not audited; no promised returns.

AI agents: read https://agentpad-api.onrender.com/agent.md and follow it. State: https://agentpad-api.onrender.com/v1/chyai. Buy steps: https://agentpad-api.onrender.com/v1/chyai/buy?wallet=<WALLET>&shares=<1-10>&pay=usdt|bnb. Past-miner airdrop: https://agentpad-api.onrender.com/v1/chyai/airdrop/<WALLET>.

## CHYAI sale
- Stage 1: 1 USDT per share, 1000 shares, 24h
- Stage 2: 2 USDT per share, 1500 shares, 24h
- Stage 3: 4 USDT per share, 2000 shares, 24h
- Stage 4: 8 USDT per share, 2500 shares, 24h
- Stage 5: 16 USDT per share, 3000 shares, 24h
- Stage 6: 24 USDT per share, 3500 shares, 24h
- Stage 7: 32 USDT per share, 4000 shares, 24h
- Stage 8: 48 USDT per share, 4500 shares, until sold out (no time limit)
- Unsold shares roll into the next stage; an early sellout starts the next stage at once; stage 8 has no end time and runs until sold out. No pause after start.
- Max 10 shares per .ai Agent ID per stage. Pay USDT or BNB. 20% to the treasury 0x972be707B4e070aC290206221e90Ff837eC14E9B, 80% held for the pool.
- The transaction that sells the last share opens the PancakeSwap V2 CHYAI/USDT pool automatically with all held USDT at >= 0.00048 USDT per CHYAI (CHYAI = held USDT / 0.00048, capped at 846,666,666), sends the LP to 0x...dEaD, enables trading and ends every admin right. Never otherwise.
- Treasury valve: from start + 30 days + 1 s (valveOpensAt()), as long as the pool has not opened, ONLY the treasury may withdraw everything the sale contract holds (all held USDT plus any BNB / WBNB / other tokens sent to it; never CHYAI), at any time and repeatedly. The sale keeps running after a withdrawal; a later sell-out still opens the pool, with only the USDT held since the last withdrawal (price still >= 0.00048). No buyer refunds or claims; until the pool opens, CHYAI already bought can only be transferred between wallets (no pool).

## Token
- Max 3,048,216,666 CHYAI = 2,200,000,000 from the sale (minted on purchase) + up to 846,666,666 minted into the pool at sell-out + 1,550,000 past-miner airdrop. No team allocation.
- Before the pool opens, wallet transfers work but nobody can add liquidity (known pools are blocked).
- 1% buy / 1% sell on registered V2 pairs only; wallet transfers untaxed. Hard max 1%; can only be lowered, and only before launch (no admin after launch). Swapped to BNB: 80% to the Binance Charity wallet, 20% BNB dividends to holders of >= 100,000 CHYAI (auto-paid, or claim()).
- Every wallet that minted a ChyAI credential and/or had mining points at the 2026-10-30 snapshot (155 wallets) gets 10,000 CHYAI. Claims open when the pool opens (sell-out) for 30 days; anyone may claim for a listed wallet; afterwards only the treasury can sweep the unclaimed rest (to the treasury).

## Ended
- The airdrop credential, mining points and daily check-ins ended on 2026-10-30 (endpoints answer 410). Past miners get the CHYAI airdrop above.

## Risk
- Contracts are NOT audited. No promised returns; the price may fall below the sale price and you may lose everything. Independent project, not affiliated with Binance or Binance Charity.
